description:
Read the per-token trading caps (TradingLimit rows) on an agent wallet.

Returns {wallet_address, trading_limits: [{token_address,
max_position_size, max_single_trade, daily_volume_limit}], enforcement}.
Caps are USD decimal strings; null = uncapped. ``enforcement`` states
which execution rails actually read each column today -- a stored cap is
not necessarily a binding one. Sibling of wallet_status
for the WalletPolicy surface.
name: get_trading_limits
